record.paper_title: Some Open Problems Related to Fixed Point Properties
record.context_brief: Left reversible semigroup actions on Hilbert spaces
record.original_question: Let S be a left reversible semitopological semigroup acting by norm nonexpansive, weakly jointly continuous self-mappings on a nonempty weakly closed subset C of a Hilbert space. Assume there exists c in C such that the orbit {T_s c : s in S} is bounded. Must C contain a common fixed point for S? Equivalently, is the separability assumption removable from the known affirmative result for separable S?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.9. Let S be a left reversible semitopological semigroup acting on a weakly closed subset C 6= ∅ of a Hilbert space as norm nonexpansive and weakly jointly continuous self mappings. Suppose that there is c ∈ C such that {Tsc : s ∈ S} is bounded. Does C contain a common fixed point for S?
The question has been answered affirmatively in [16, Theorem 4.8] for the case that S is separable. We wonder whether the separability condition is removable.

artifact.category_tag: Fixed point theory for semigroup actions
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not locate any published resolution of the non-separable case. The affirmative answer is known for separable left reversible semigroups acting on weakly closed subsets of Hilbert spaces, and the problem is posed explicitly as open in a recent collection of open problems on fixed point properties. No subsequent paper appears to claim the removal of separability.

status_evidence.title: The τ-fixed point property for left reversible semigroups
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses τ-fixed point properties for left reversible semitopological semigroups with nonexpansive actions, in settings related to (but not resolving) the non-separable Hilbert case.
status_evidence.claim: Related results on left reversible semigroup fixed point properties exist, but do not remove separability in the Hilbert space setting.

status_evidence.title: Fixed point properties for semigroups of nonlinear mappings on unbounded sets
status_evidence.snippet: Considers fixed point results for semigroups of nonexpansive mappings; the affirmative answer for separable S is referenced as Theorem 4.8 type results.
status_evidence.claim: Affirmative result is established under separability; non-separable case is not addressed.
